verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a set of real-time communications components (messaging, audio, video, screen share) for embedding in apps. It is not an AI agent or assistant host that consumes tools, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows any MCP client or agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
